title: Our Purpose
description: Vision, mission, journey, philosophy, values, and compliance — the foundations that guide Hijaz Hospital's commitment to compassionate, accessible healthcare for all.

hero.title: Our Purpose
hero.excerpt: The vision, journey, and values that keep quality care within reach for every patient who walks through our doors.

vision: To develop Hijaz Hospital into a state-of-the-art secondary-level healthcare institution that serves all strata of society with excellence and compassion
mission: To care for the ailing with compassion, respect, dignity, and professional excellence, while ensuring that financial hardship never stands in the way of receiving care

journey.title: Trial & Perseverance
body: In 1968, when the author initiated the construction of Hijaz Mosque, a truck belonging to the Lahore Encroachment arrived and, within moments, demolished the mosque walls, reducing them to rubble. Upon learning of this incident, Mr. Mir Salahuddin, whose residence was adjacent to the mosque, was deeply distressed. He accompanied me to meet the Trust’s Town Planner, Mr. Irshad Ahmed, and requested his cooperation in the construction of the mosque. However, he categorically stated that he would never allow a mosque to be built during his lifetime, though he would fully support the construction of a park or a fire brigade station. Shortly thereafter, the said Town Planner was suspended.

journey.title: Completion of Hijaz Mosque
body: In 1970, with the wholehearted support of Begum Ehsan Qadir (Principal, Government Girls College), M. Hussain Chaudhry (Chartered Accountant), and the late Mir Salahuddin, the construction of the mosque was successfully completed.

journey.title: Proposal for Hijaz Hospital
body: In 1979, the author proposed the establishment of a hospital on the land adjacent to the mosque. Although the proposal was accepted in principle, approvals from the Corporation and the LDA remained elusive for seven years. Eventually, through the efforts of the late Mian Zaka-ur-Rehman and with the facilitation of General Ansari, approval was secured within just seven days.

journey.title: Foundation Stone & Dispensary
body: In 1986, the foundation stone of the hospital was laid by the renowned scholar Dr. Israr Ahmed (RA). On 15 January 1988, my respected elder and close friend, Maulana Muhammad Malik Kandhlavi (RA), inaugurated the dispensary. In the early stages, my long-standing associates—Mian Muhammad Aslam (Chairman, Sargodha Group) and Mahmood Ali Bhatti (Chairman, Punjab Steel)—stood by me as pillars of support.

journey.title: Structural Construction
body: After the completion of the underground structure, Mian Abdul Waheed single-handedly constructed the ground floor. The first floor was completed with the special cooperation of Chaudhry Muhammad Rasheed, Engineer Rasheed, and Mujahid Butt. The contributions of the Chiniot community and members of the Chamber are also gratefully acknowledged.

journey.title: Formal Registration & Expansion
body: On 13 December 1988, Hijaz Hospital Welfare was formally registered. By 1994, medical and surgical equipment worth one Crore rupees was acquired for a building of equivalent value, and an additional property worth one crore rupees was purchased to generate rental income.

journey.title: Governance & Executive Expansion
body: In 1993, Sheikh Habibullah, former Chairman of the Pakistan Hardware Merchants Association, assumed the role of General Secretary. In 1995, the Executive Committee was expanded, and regular monthly meetings of the governing body commenced.

journey.title: Leadership & Academic Contributors
body: Several distinguished individuals contributed selflessly to the hospital’s administration and development, including Sheikh Taimur-ul-Haq, Tauqeer Ahmed Sharifi, Al-Haj Mian Abdul Waheed, Aziz A. Mughal, and Sheikh Khushnood Ahmed. Eminent scholars and intellectuals associated with the institution include Dr. Naseem Hassan Shah, Dr. Ikram H. Syed, Professor Altaf Ali Qureshi, and Chaudhry Muhammad Rasheed Khan.

journey.title: Medical Advisory Leadership
body: Dr. M. Afzal Sheikh, Chief Executive of Shalamar Hospital and Medical Advisor to Hijaz Hospital, has proven to be a valuable asset for the institution.

philosophy.heading: A Legacy of Faith, Service, and Compassion
philosophy.body: Founded on enduring values, Hijaz Hospital has grown from a vision of service into a trusted healthcare institution. Guided by faith, compassion, and professional excellence, we are committed to providing quality healthcare that meets the physical, emotional, and social needs of our patients.

approachHeading: How We Put Care Into Practice

approach.body: Delivering patient-centered care with empathy, dignity, and respect.

approach.title: Advanced Medical Technology
approach.body: Utilizing modern healthcare technologies for accurate diagnosis and effective treatment.

approach.title: 24/7 Service
approach.body: Ensuring continuous access to quality medical care whenever it is needed.

approach.title: Holistic Care
approach.body: Addressing the physical, emotional, and social well-being of patients.

approach.title: Patient Safety & Quality
approach.body: Upholding the highest standards of safety, quality, and clinical excellence.

approach.title: Community Outreach
approach.body: Extending healthcare services and awareness programs to underserved communities.

approach.title: Skilled & Dedicated Professionals
approach.body: Empowering experienced healthcare teams to provide exceptional care.

valuesIntro: At Hijaz Hospital Trust, our work is guided by compassion, integrity, excellence, and a commitment to serving humanity. We believe quality healthcare should be accessible to all, especially the deserving and underserved, and we strive to create a healthier and more equitable society through ethical, patient-centered care.

values.title: Care
values.body: Putting patients and their well-being at the center of everything we do.

values.title: Concern
values.body: Responding thoughtfully to the needs of patients, families, staff, and communities.

values.title: Empathy and Compassion
values.body: Providing care with kindness, understanding, and sensitivity.

values.title: Integrity
values.body: Upholding honesty, accountability, and professionalism in all our actions.

values.title: Respect
values.body: Treating every individual with dignity, fairness, and courtesy.

values.title: Justice and Equity
values.body: Ensuring fair and equal access to quality healthcare.

values.title: Excellence through Teamwork
values.body: Collaborating to achieve the highest standards of care and service.

values.title: Ethical Practices and Transparency
values.body: Maintaining openness, responsibility, and good governance.

values.title: Diversity, Inclusion, and Gender Equality
values.body: Fostering an environment where everyone is valued and has equal opportunities.

valuesOutro: These values shape our culture, guide our decisions, and inspire our commitment to improving lives and serving our community.
complianceIntro: Hijaz Hospital is committed to adhere to all applicable healthcare regulations, quality standards, ethical practices, and governance requirements, ensuring safe, transparent, and accountable healthcare services for all.
